subject: wellspring-rotations
label: The Wellspring — crystal cart and sorting table, all 8 faces
notes: RAHEEM APPROVED BOTH, 2026-08-04: 'the well crystal cart, that's awesome... the well sorting table, they're all amazing. Go ahead and generate the other angles of those two, because those are beautiful.'

THE CART WAS DEHALOED FIRST, AND THE ORDER MATTERS. It came back with a pale matting fringe — 42% of its edge pixels were near-white, against 0% on the sorting table beside it. /create-8-direction-object takes the sprite as its `reference_image`, so a halo in the source would have propagated into ALL EIGHT faces. One free fix beforehand instead of eight dirty sprites afterwards. lib/dehalo.py, 6 passes, 0% remaining, and only 8.9% of pixels removed so the art survived.
The sorting table needed no cleaning — measured at 0% near-white edge.

Both objects have a definite front, so a turn is genuinely visible and the rotation buys something real. This is the same test that spared the crystal and the mana font, which are radially symmetric and got one face each.
COST: a rotation pass measured 40 generations on the card stand and lectern, so budget ~80 for the pair.

/create-8-direction-object rejects `size` when `reference_image` is supplied — the reference's own dimensions decide the output. And its `view` enum is 'low top-down' | 'high top-down' | 'side', NOT the 'top-down' that the 1-direction endpoint takes.

rotations.note: Dehaloed source. A cart is strongly front-facing — wheels, handle, open bed — so every face reads differently.
